title: Making an MMO
author: rectangle_so
selftext:
Behold the King of Kings, Eggon the Conqueror 

For the 2 weekish I’ve been working on a 2D mmo. I think I’ve got the style down, it will use my eggs from the [eggverse.](http://eggverse.co) Growing up I loved playing MMOs and had always dreamed of making it happen. Now it’s happening. I’m taking inspiration from MMOs I loved such as maplestory and guild wars 2 are big inspirations.

story, gameplay and combat are what i'm on right now. 

Thinking of splitting the story into 3 parts. Trying to make it light hearted and fun, but also deep and dark like Elden Ring, Attack on Titan, Game of thrones etc 

question for anyone who's played a lot of MMOs:   
what made you keep logging in the combat, events & story, or the social part? what do you wish MMOs had but never did? 

& do you think AI could change the way these games are played? 

Every week I’ll post my progress and hope to get a private alpha within a month or two. If you’re interested in testing/collaborating/sharing ideas would love to talk

comments.author: -jp-
comments.body:
\> question for anyone who's played a lot of MMOs:     
what made you keep logging in the combat, events & story, or the social part? what do you wish MMOs had but never did? 

The community. It’s *always* the community. You can’t AI that. You have to nurture it.

replies.author: rectangle_so
replies.body: I meant more of gameplay and mechanics but I agree with you!

replies.author: DoeblerBrandon
replies.body: i love having small progression that i can make regardless of event or anything else. I love skill leveling for this reason. It doesn't really matter what the skill is im leaving as long as the XP bar on said skill goes up.

replies.author: rectangle_so
replies.body:
Okkok that’s definitely something I’m working on right now. I’ve got stats that you can allot skill points to as well as ability points you can use on your skills to make them stronger! 

Do you like achievements or don’t really care?  
And is there like other type of skills you would like to see potentially? I.e like a fishing skill?
